name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons)
eligibility: Indian citizen with 40% or more disability, monthly income under ₹20,000.
benefits: Free or subsidised aids, motorized tricycles, braille kits, hearing aids.
simplified: If you have a 40%+ disability certificate and earn less than 20,000 per month, the government gives you free wheelchairs, hearing aids, or braille kits.

name: Aasara Pension for Persons with Disabilities
eligibility: Telangana resident, SADAREM certificate with 40%+ disability (any age).
benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹4,016 directly transferred to bank account.
simplified: People with 40% disability living in Telangana receive 4,016 rupees in their bank account every month.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a verified benchmark disability.
benefits: National unified digital card for availing travel concessions, state welfare, and healthcare.
simplified: One single official smart card for all disability benefits and train/bus travel discounts nationwide.

name: National Fellowship for Persons with Disabilities (NFPwD)
eligibility: Students with benchmark disability pursuing regular M.Phil / Ph.D.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹31,000 to ₹35,000 plus contingency allowance for 5 years.
simplified: Financial support for higher education (research and doctorate) for students with disability.
